messages.subject: Expiring waivers spike on dashboard
messages.body: Hi, our dashboard shows 214 'expiring' waivers this month. Normally it's around 20. Is something wrong with the report? Imani Calloway, Crux Hall

messages.subject: Re: Ticket #88213 - Expiring waivers spike on dashboard
messages.body:
Hi Imani,

Thanks for your patience. Our 4.8 release on October 1 switched the default 'Validity basis' for waivers from 'signature date' to 'account created date' on some accounts. Members whose profiles are older than 12 months now show as expired or missing at check-in, even if they signed recently.

To fix it: Settings > Waivers > Validity basis > Signature date, then click 'Recalculate statuses'. It takes a few minutes.

Sorry for the trouble!
Alicia
SignPeak Support

opportunities.what: Paula, Ken and Lumen's team were all told their waivers were missing or expired; SignPeak's 4.8 release changed the validity basis and support gave the fix. Switch the setting, recalculate, and reply to all three (and pre-check Lumen's December group).

Westbrook Parks (by Nov 30) and the school district (by Dec 4) both need a COI naming them as additional insured plus background clearances, and two coaches' checks expire in November. One request to the broker for both COIs and one clearance roster serve both.

Northgate's renewal (Dec 15) is at risk: their staff complain at the desk that the homeschool club fills the lunch hour, and HR reports usage down 40% at lunch. Hold the auto invoice and offer Joel a fix (a reserved lunch block) before the renewal.
Lucía is looking for a physical therapist who knows climbing injuries for her daughter's finger; Nadia is a climbing-focused PT who asked for referrals. Introduce them.
Ross booked concert tickets and dinner for Saturday Dec 12, and Tasha asked the owner to babysit that same evening. Sort out the clash with both before it's too late.
Dad can't drive to the airport; Jonah lands in Dayton Dec 23 at 2:10pm and Tasha's family of four at 1:20pm the same day. Plan one airport pickup (big enough car) on the owner's drive down.

traps.what: November 21 is both the youth regionals in Columbus and AirPro's filter visit at the gym; unrelated.
A friend's personal shoe resole question and the gym's rental shoe resole quote share a topic but must not be joined.
The late chalk and rope orders are already covered by an open to-do to chase both suppliers.
Lane 3 auto belay was out with a party coming up, but AscendSafe replaced it and Rory put it back in service.
The 'raise your day-pass price' pattern appears only in newsletters and promos.
Volunteers and press for the Sept 19 open house: over more than 30 days ago.
Sam Rivera the setter applicant and Sam Rivera the fire inspector are different people.
Griffwerk and Summit Holds are rival hold brands each asking for exclusive Jam sponsorship; a joint message would expose each to the other.
Lena's message already says exactly what to do: email Rory's finished rope log to Nate.
'Atlas' is both a training board Rory wants and the bookkeeping software renewal; unrelated.
